fields.description:
## Context / Problem

On 2026-11-01, 3 plan reviews were billed and lost. One review ran against a clone that had genuinely diverged from `origin/tickets`, so it read a superseded description and replayed an old BLOCK. `gate_status` then labelled that 19-minute-old `REVIEW_RESULT` as `current-review-result-sidecar`. The failure reason also told the caller to run `sign-review` when no PASS result file existed, so that command could not succeed. The root-cause comment of 2026-11-03 has the evidence. The compaction lock that caused the divergence is fixed separately (`radiant-benighted-warbler`, landed `25bce6c0550`).

Operator decision, 2026-11-03: **the client must be able to run offline without knowing anything about the remote store.** Today a clone with unpublished local writes cannot review, claim or close. `store_freshness` (`src/rebar/_store/freshness.py:174`) reports `push-pending` as stale, and every gate refuses on that. This rescope supersedes that part of `cibophobic-moist-guineafowl` (b928), `yummy-yogic-clam` (2d52-5abe-abb8-44ab) and `abnormal-dear-shoveler` (16c9-a42d-fd01-48b9). Accepted trade-off: a certificate can cover events the shared store has not received yet.

## Approach

1. **Push-pending no longer makes a store stale.** In `store_freshness`, drop the `elif pending:` branch (`freshness.py:222`) and remove `push-pending` from `_STALE_VERDICTS` (`freshness.py:45`). Delete `_pending_reconciled` and `_head_is_level_with` (`freshness.py:99`, `:129`), which exist only to discharge the marker for that branch; `grep` finds no other caller in `src/`. The marker itself is untouched. `push_state.record_failure` still writes it, and `fsck` still reports `PUSH_PENDING` (`fsck_tracker_health.py:215-227`). Behind and diverged remain stale, decided by the existing purely local `_ref_divergence` (`freshness.py:69`). It returns `None` when the remote-tracking ref does not resolve, so a clone that was never fetched, or has no remote, counts as fresh. All 3 gates call `store_freshness`: the claim gate (`attest_gate.py:133`), the plan-review close gate (`gates.py:204`) and the completion close gate (`close_precheck.py:681` through `assert_gate_store_fresh`). The one change therefore covers all 3, and none of the call sites needs editing.
2. **review-plan refuses a behind or diverged clone before any LLM call.** In `_run_plan_review` (`src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py`), call `store_freshness` after `collect_plan_relation_snapshot` (`:382`, whose `force_fresh` sync is the review's only network step) and before `assemble_context` (`:413`). When the store is not fresh, return an unsigned INDETERMINATE verdict built by `claimability.indeterminate_verdict` (`claimability.py:127`). It carries finding id `stale-store`, `coverage.llm_ran: false`, `signature.reason: "stale-store"` and the freshness reason, and exits 2. The check runs even with `--force`, because a forced review would still certify stale material. This placement reuses the existing early-verdict builder, the same one the not-claimable fast-fail uses, so the refusal costs nothing.
3. **gate_status labels replayed results.** `_gate_sidecar_fields` (`src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py:162`) records `verdict_replayed: true` when the result's `runner` is `"reused"`, as set by both `reuse.verdict_reuse` and `reuse.idempotent_reuse`. Otherwise it records `false`. `_review_result_status` (`src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py:243`) then reports reason `replayed-review-result-sidecar` instead of `current-review-result-sidecar` for a replayed run. Both reasons add `decided_by_run`: `false` for a replay, `true` for a run that emitted its own sidecar, and `null` for records written before this field existed.
4. **sign-review advice only when a PASS exists.** `_uncertified_plan_review_reason` (`attest_gate.py:99`) names `rebar sign-review` only when `sidecar.latest_review_result` (`sidecar.py:147`) returns a payload whose `verdict` is `PASS`. Otherwise it names only `rebar review-plan`.
5. Update the module and `store_freshness` docstrings in `freshness.py`, and the docs: `docs/concurrency.md` §stale-store (`:639`, which lists push-pending as stale) and `docs/plan-review-gate.md` (review-plan's stale-store refusal, the offline posture, and the `gate_status` findings fields next to `findings.readable` at `:794`).

## Scope

- src/rebar/_store/freshness.py
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/__init__.py
- src/rebar/llm/plan_review/attest_gate.py
- src/rebar/_mcp_llm.py
- src/rebar/llm/gate_runs.py
- docs/concurrency.md, docs/plan-review-gate.md
- tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py (update the push-pending tests)
- tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py (new)

Out of scope: the compaction lock (`radiant-benighted-warbler`) and the `_ref_divergence` predicate itself.

## Testing

All tests are written to fail first, and none uses an autouse fixture. Each uses real git clones (an origin, a tracker and a second writer), as `tests/unit/test_gate_store_freshness.py` already does.

- Happy path: a clone that is ahead of `origin/tickets` and carries a push-pending marker passes the claim gate, the plan-review close gate and the completion close gate's freshness assertion. The same holds for a level clone with a marker. A clone with no `origin/tickets` ref, and one with no remote, also pass.
- Failure path: a clone that is behind, and one that has diverged from its fetched ref, are refused by all 3 gates with `stale-store`. `_run_plan_review` on a behind clone returns INDETERMINATE `stale-store`, and a runner stub that raises proves no LLM call was made.
- Replay: a `gate_status` record whose result has `runner: "reused"` reports `replayed-review-result-sidecar` with `decided_by_run: false`. A fresh run reports `current-review-result-sidecar` with `decided_by_run: true`.
- Advice: with no sidecar, or only a BLOCK sidecar, the claim-gate reason omits `sign-review`. With a PASS sidecar, it includes it.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] An ahead or level clone carrying a push-pending marker passes all 3 gates' freshness checks. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k push_pending`.
- [ ] A behind or diverged clone is refused by all 3 gates with verdict `stale-store`. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k "behind or diverged"`.
- [ ] `review-plan` on a behind or diverged clone returns INDETERMINATE `stale-store` with no LLM call. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k review_plan`.
- [ ] A clone with no fetched ref, or with no remote, counts as fresh. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k "no_fetch or no_remote"`.
- [ ] `gate_status` labels a replayed result `replayed-review-result-sidecar`, with `decided_by_run` reported. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k replay`.
- [ ] The claim-gate reason names `sign-review` only when a PASS `REVIEW_RESULT` exists. Checked by `pytest tests/unit/test_offline_gate_freshness_529c.py -k sign_review`.
- [ ] `fsck` still reports `PUSH_PENDING` for an ahead clone with the marker. Checked by `pytest tests/interfaces/store/test_fsck_push_pending.py` passing unchanged.
- [ ] `make lint` and `make typecheck` exit 0, and the freshness, gate, close-precheck, MCP and plan-review test modules pass. Checked by running them with the worktree `.venv/bin` first on PATH.
